name: Twin Falls County, ID
findings: Twin Falls County has 241 nonprofit organizations. 102 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Twin Falls County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Twin Falls County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 101 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 1 social and fraternal organization here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 5 health care organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
